Plot spatial distribution of catch

Source: R/hr_techreport_plot_catchspatial.R
hr_techreport_plot_catchspatial.Rd

Creates a map of catch per unit tow area (t/nm²) for the selected years, overlaid on ocean depth contours. Each grid cell is rounded to one decimal degree of latitude and longitude. If more than one year is supplied, years are shown as facets.

Usage

hr_techreport_plot_catchspatial(
  pcon,
  years,
  low_res = TRUE,
  breaks = c(0, 1, 2, seq(3, 20, by = 3), 40, 60),
  na.fill = -50
)

Arguments

pcon

A database connection object compatible with dplyr::tbl.

years

Integer vector of years to map.

low_res

Logical. If TRUE (the default), uses a lower resolution base map (faster to render).

breaks

Colour breaks of the catch (t/nm²). The default (0 to 60 t/nm²) suits the large stocks; a stock with small catches per area needs finer breaks, e.g. seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.1).

na.fill

Value given to cells without catch, see pax::pax_map_layer_catch(). Default -50.

Value

A ggplot2 plot object.
